components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type

          type: string
          format: uri

          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:

          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500

        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true

          type: string
          format: date-time

          maxLength: 30

        lastName:
          title: Last name

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin

          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison

          maxLength: 20

              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3

              type: string
              readOnly: true

              type: string
              readOnly: true
